name: National Scholarship Portal (Central Post-Matric Scholarship)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / Minority Affairs
benefitSummary: ₹22,000/year tuition reimbursement + maintenance allowance via NSP DBT
statutoryRule: NSP OTR Guidelines 2024-26: Student can hold only ONE Central Sector scholarship at a time. Family income ≤ ₹2.5L.
commonRejectionTrap: Aadhaar not seeded with NPCI mapper or Institute KYC pending on NSP portal.
cscSteps: Login to scholarships.gov.in → Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) → Face Auth via NSP App → Select Post-Matric Scheme → Upload RD Certificate.

name: PM-USP Central Sector Scholarship for College Students
ministry: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
statutoryRule: Ministry of Education Notification: Mutually exclusive with other Central Scholarships under NSP; Hakku automatically selects the higher-paying scholarship.
commonRejectionTrap: Class 12 percentile verification pending from State Board.
cscSteps: scholarships.gov.in → Student Login → Dept of Higher Education → PM-USP Central Sector Scheme.

name: Karnataka SSP & Vidyasiri Food/Hostel Stipend
ministry: Backward Classes / Social Welfare Dept, Govt of Karnataka
benefitSummary: ₹1,500/month for 10 months (₹15,000/yr) for non-hostel students + tuition fee concession
statutoryRule: Karnataka Sakala Act SLA: 21 Working Days. Requires 75%+ attendance and valid Nadakacheri RD Number.
commonRejectionTrap: Name spelling mismatch between SSLC marksheet and Aadhaar Card.
cscSteps: ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in → Create SSP Account → Enter RD Number from Nadakacheri → e-Attestation by College Nodal Officer.

name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
benefitSummary: ₹6,000/year in 3 installments of ₹2,000 via Aadhaar DBT
statutoryRule: PM-KISAN Operational Guidelines Para 4: Institutional landholders, Income Tax payers in last assessment year, and regular Govt employees are statutorily excluded.
commonRejectionTrap: e-KYC incomplete or Land Seeding marked 'NO' in Tehsil records.
cscSteps: pmkisan.gov.in → Farmers Corner → Complete OTP/Biometric e-KYC → Verify Land Seeding = YES & Aadhaar Bank Seeding = YES.

name: PM-KUSUM Solar Agricultural Pump Subsidy (Component-B)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
benefitSummary: Up to 60% government subsidy on solar irrigation pumps (saves ~₹45,000/yr in diesel/power)
statutoryRule: MNRE PM-KUSUM Guidelines: 30% Central + 30% State subsidy; 10% farmer contribution (30% bank loan facility).
commonRejectionTrap: Applying through fake private websites instead of official state nodal portal.
cscSteps: Apply ONLY via pmkusum.mnre.gov.in or State Renewable Energy Nodal Agency (KREDL) portal when quota window opens.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
benefitSummary: Govt pays ~85% of actuarial premium; farmer pays only 1.5%–2% for full crop loss coverage
statutoryRule: PMFBY Revamped Guidelines: Localised calamity/hailstorm intimation must be filed within 72 hours on Crop Insurance App or 14447 helpline.
commonRejectionTrap: Crop name mismatch between RTC Pahani crop survey and bank portal entry.
cscSteps: pmfby.gov.in → Farmer Application → Select Season (Kharif/Rabi) → Enter Survey Number → Pay nominal 2% premium.

name: NSAP Indira Gandhi Old Age Pension + Sandhya Suraksha
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development / Directorate of Social Security
statutoryRule: Social Security Pension Rules: A beneficiary can draw only ONE social security pension (Old Age OR Widow OR Disability) at a time.
commonRejectionTrap: Annual Life Certificate (Jeevan Pramaan) e-KYC not renewed.
cscSteps: sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in / Nadakacheri → Sandhya Suraksha / IGNOAPS → Village Accountant Field Verification within 21 Sakala days.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension / Destitute Widow Pension
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development / State Social Security Dept
benefitSummary: ₹1,200/month (₹14,400/year) lifetime monthly pension credited directly via DBT
statutoryRule: Mutually exclusive with Old-Age Pension under NSAP rules; Hakku prevents duplicate pension filing that would trigger recovery notices.
commonRejectionTrap: Husband's Death Certificate registration number not linked to e-JanMa portal.
cscSteps: Nadakacheri / Seva Sindhu → Destitute Widow Pension → Attach Death Certificate & Ration Card.

name: Gruha Lakshmi (₹2,000/mo) & Shakti Free Bus Transit
ministry: Dept of Women and Child Development, Govt of Karnataka
benefitSummary: ₹2,000/month (₹24,000/year) DBT to woman head of household + free state bus travel
statutoryRule: Govt Order WCD 2023: Payable strictly to ONE woman head listed on Ration Card. Excluded if woman or husband pays Income Tax or files GST returns.
commonRejectionTrap: Ration card e-KYC incomplete or bank account NPCI DBT status inactive.
documents: Antyodaya / BPL / APL Ration Card (showing Woman Head)
cscSteps: sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in → Gruha Lakshmi → Verify Ration Card RC Number → No fee charged at GramaOne/KarnatakaOne.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY + 70+ Senior Citizen Vay Vandana
ministry: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health
benefitSummary: ₹5,00,000/year cashless hospitalization per family (plus ₹5L top-up for seniors aged 70+ regardless of income)
statutoryRule: NHA 2024 Amendment: All senior citizens aged 70+ are eligible for ₹5L cover irrespective of income; BPL/priority families covered at all ages.
commonRejectionTrap: Trying to apply after emergency admission instead of pre-generating Ayushman e-Card via beneficiary.nha.gov.in.
cscSteps: beneficiary.nha.gov.in → Login with Mobile → Search by Ration Card / Aadhaar → Complete e-KYC → Download Ayushman Card immediately.
